newsitem.title: USA: RLI Corp debentures converted to stock.
newsitem.headline: RLI Corp debentures converted to stock.

text.p: RLI Corp said Thursday $46 million of its called outstanding 6 percent convertible debentures have been converted into RLI stock.
The bonds were converted, at the option of the individual holders, at an exchange rate of 38.4615 shares of stock for each $1,000 principal amount of bonds held ($26 per share conversion price).
The conversion created an additional 1,769,199 new shares of RLI stock outstanding, the company said. The closing price of RLI stock on July 23 was $37.50 a share.
The bonds, which were to mature July 15, 2003, were called by the company in June and were to be redeemed for cash at 103 percent of their principal amount, plus accrued interest, on July 22.
